messages:
incidents-bot: Pager: billing/metering anomaly detected — burst of delayed usage ingestion followed by retroactive overage flags for several customers. Severity: P2. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metering-delay. Please ack and follow handoff.
oncall-sre: acked. I'm ish oncall. Looking at emitter and ingest backlog.
billing-eng: seeing a spike in "retry_dedup" count on the proxy tier, and delayed window commits from midnight onwards. Possible double-replay suppression causing delayed aggregates.
oncall-sre: patching a quick view — tailing emitter logs now. cmd: ```kubectl logs -n billing emitter-xyz --since=10m | grep 'emit-window' | tail -n 50``` — lots of 429 retries and then batch flushes.
mike-ops: noticed ratecap throttle on the HTTP proxy from 00:12-00:28 UTC — proxies returned 429 which caused client-side backoff and then bursts when back online. That aligns with delayed emits.
billing-eng: delta: tokens counted in live ledger are low until the backfill; shadow-agg shows correct counts. So customers got temporary under-reporting earlier then got overage flags when backfill landed.
cs-lead: @mike-ops any customers impacted yet? we have one ticket from Acme who saw an overage alert at 03:05 UTC.
oncall-sre: confirmed ~12 accounts received automated overage flags after backfill at 03:01. Impact window ~00:10-03:00 UTC. Severity: customer-visible but self-healing once backfill finishes.
anna-pm: priority: reduce customer noise (alerts/overage) and prevent billing correctness regressions. Options: (1) pause overage alerting until reconciliation completes, (2) throttle back reconciliation to apply deltas in controlled windows, (3) issue temporary credits if needed.
billing-eng: I can run a targeted cancelation of overage alerts and enqueue a controlled replay. Plan: (a) flip feature flag billing.alerts.pause=true for affected accounts, (b) trigger incremental reconciliation job with small batches and validation, (c) generate reconciliation report and notify CS.
oncall-sre: +1. How long to run replay? billing-eng: estimate 45-60m for full shard, partial for top accounts ~10-15m. I'll start with top 50 impacted accounts.
yousef-rt: I'll prepare monitoring dashboards for delta checks and set an alert if reconciliation delta > 5% after replay.
incidents-bot: Action log created: INCIDENT-1961234567. Assigned to billing-eng, oncall-sre. Webhook: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1961234567
mike-ops: executed: billing.alerts.pause=true for accounts [acct-123, acct-234, acct-345] — confirmed via admin UI. Setting temporary silence in pagerduty for the next 90m for this alert class.
billing-eng: started replay for acct-123. Sample logs: ```INFO reconcile: acct=acct-123 start=00:10 end=03:00 delta_tokens=+1,234 emit_batches=23``` — applying via dry-run first.
oncall-sre: dry-run shows ledger delta matching shadow-agg for sample. Proceeding to apply on acct-123.
cs-lead: CS note drafted: "We observed an ingestion delay affecting usage visibility between 00:10-03:00 UTC. You might have received an overage alert; we've paused alerts for impacted accounts while we reconcile. We'll follow up with any credits if applicable." — ready to send when we have full list.
anna-pm: please capture root-cause hypothesis in the incident doc. Looks like transient ratecapping on proxy -> retries -> burst backfill -> alerting cascade. Also verify autoscaling settings on proxy tier.
yousef-rt: dashboard pinned: reconciliation progress graph, retry_dedup trend, proxy-429 rate. Setting a 5% delta guardrail.
billing-eng: applied reconcile for acct-123 and acct-234. Post-apply delta: acct-123 +1,234 tokens (no change to billed amount after credit rules), acct-234 +9,876 tokens (will trigger review for potential credit). Applying to next batch.
oncall-sre: mitigation checklist: 1) alerts paused (done), 2) controlled replays (in progress), 3) customer comms queued (CS), 4) fix for proxy ratecap threshold being too aggressive (follow-up). Marking incident as "mitigating".
cs-lead: sending targeted messages to impacted contacts now. Template: short explanation + link to status page + ETA for resolution.
anna-pm: scheduling post-incident review. Need owners: billing-eng (root-cause), eng-infra (proxy settings), oncall-sre (runbook friction), cs (customer comms).
billing-eng: reconcile complete for top 50 accounts. Summary: majority deltas small (<2% tokens), 5 accounts >8% needing credit review. Preparing CSV for finance.
yousef-rt: verification pass completed. No lingering backfill jobs. retry_dedup counts returned to baseline. Marking monitoring green in last 5m.
oncall-sre: reverting temporary silence after confirming alerts suppressed during replay. Keep billing.alerts.pause flag on until final report done.
cs-lead: all impacted customers notified. One customer requested immediate credit — escalated to finance via ticket #FIN-4021.
anna-pm: incident state -> monitoring. We'll keep as postmortem candidate. Thanks everyone.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT-1961234567 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Timeline and action items saved to https://redwood.internal/incidents/1961234567/postmortem
mike-ops: follow-up action: increase proxy ratecap thresholds for emitter clients and add a burst queue to smooth client replays. Filing infra ticket INFRA-789.
billing-eng: follow-up action: add reconcile autosanity check to prevent retroactive overage triggers until verification passes.
oncall-sre: final note: if anyone needs raw logs or sample commands, ping me. Closing thread for live handoff.
cs-lead: thanks all :heart:
